spec.scene: A warm kitchen patch paved with rustic terracotta tiles. At the center, an older woman in a floral apron and a grandchild in a yellow shirt sit beside a wide wooden table, folding pale dried corn husks around fresh tamales. On the left side of the table, a woven basket overflows with ripe orange-red mangos, next to a jar of bright yellow flowers. To the right, a small vintage wooden radio rests beside a tall steaming metal pot, bathed in warm amber afternoon light pouring from a window frame at the back edge.
spec.title: Tamales con la Abuela
spec.caption: Pasamos toda la tarde preparando tamales y escuchando viejos boleros juntos.
